scope: CPU NumPy only, local files; no inference/control, network, GPU, labels research or original-asset writes
reference_limit: 42681-row a3_fw upstream 8D + calibration-matched actual force18 gathered channels; constructed 14D reference is not recovered a3_fw_v1g nor proof of original statistics identity. Marginal range only; in-range does not establish joint/temporal ID.

normalizer_contract.force_conditioner: (raw_newton-mean)/std * scale; no amplitude clamp; only valid history used in comparisons

findings.association: All nine seed17 severe-state traces (frames143/159/207, 3 noises each) have all six force-proprio coordinates8:14 saturated at +5 and all six valid-history force channels outside actual source ranges. History remains unclamped and reaches about2175.68 calibration std at frame207. This is association, not causal attribution.
findings.normalizer_vs_source: Force slots in reconstructed min/max are symmetric +/- calibration std, NOT actual source extrema. Actual-source in-range force can therefore normalize beyond1, and clip presence is not itself sufficient proof of training-source OOD. Use raw/source comparison separately.
findings.specific_motion_ood: Base coordinate2 z: 0.761320/0.744069/0.733227 vs source[0.763831,0.919999]; coordinate4 axis-angle-y:1.239154/1.279420/1.527308 vs max1.233620. Frame143 also coordinate5 below min. Rotation coordinates are representation-dependent, not automatically physical orientation novelty.
findings.trace: Protocol gripper after-step maxima: frame143 2.391->12.312, frame159 4.25->32.5, frame207 6.375->101.5; initial Gaussian gripper maxima1.898/2.516/2.516. Amplification begins early, accumulates through10 exact BF16 Euler steps; no action scheduler arithmetic discrepancy found.
findings.co_amplification: Not gripper-only: frame207 protocol final action per-dim absmax [9,34.25,32,31.125,22.875,4.53125,101.5]; all7 exceed1, not all exceed5. Future force all6 channels leave source range; protocol gripper-force channel peaks43.002/107.680/176.902 N at frames143/159/207 vs training max2.952N. Future-force per-step timing unavailable.
findings.counterexamples: Seed11f98 saturates coord10 and has history OOD yet final gripper absmax0.871..1.078; seed11f332 multiple saturations but gripper1.469..1.766. Thus OOD/saturation not sufficient and scalar max normalized proprio cannot rank severity. Seed11/12/17f0 no source-marginal input OOD yet gripper slightly>1; >1 alone not evidence of severe explosion. Seed11f47 is intermediate: gripper3.953..4.781, motion2.359..2.703, future force12.984..16.480std.

limitations: Trace records action Euler states/velocities only; no per-step future-force intermediate trace, so future-force amplification timing cannot be established.
Selected correlated closed-loop states and repeated noise are not independent randomized interventions.
Raw action >1 alone is not explosion; initial Gaussian noise naturally exceeds 1. Report final per-dim values, >5/>10 onset and controls.
counterevidence_conditions: An OOD-but-normal-output state refutes sufficiency; a severe output with no marginal input OOD refutes necessity for that marginal criterion.
Proprio clamp saturation shared by mild/severe states cannot alone explain severity; unchanged input across noise with output variation shows other determinants.

If matched-noise replacing only offending input coordinates does not reproducibly reduce severe amplitudes, the specific-coordinate causal hypothesis weakens; nonspecific reductions from unrelated replacements weaken selectivity.
